/events/2023-05-08-huberman-lab-psilocyb.title: Huberman Lab releases a full episode on psilocybin's mechanisms, therapeutic evidence, and risks
/events/2023-05-08-huberman-lab-psilocyb.extract: Andrew Huberman's podcast devoted an episode to how psilocybin acts on serotonin receptors and neuroplasticity, clinical trial evidence in depression and addiction, dosing categories, and who should avoid it.

/events/2024-07-17-washu-psilocybin-desy.title: Washington University study in Nature shows psilocybin desynchronizes the brain's default mode network, with some changes lasting weeks
/events/2024-07-17-washu-psilocybin-desy.extract: Using precision functional MRI with about 18 scans per person, WashU researchers showed a 25 mg psilocybin dose massively disrupts default mode network synchrony, with a reduction in hippocampal-DMN connectivity persisting for weeks.

/events/2025-03-31-colorado-first-healin.title: Colorado issues its first licensed psilocybin healing center license to The Center Origin in Denver
/events/2025-03-31-colorado-first-healin.extract: Colorado's Natural Medicine Division issued the state's first healing center license under Proposition 122 to The Center Origin, a wellness center in downtown Denver, opening the door to regulated psilocybin sessions for adults.

/events/2026-01-26-rand-psychedelic-use-.title: RAND survey: about 11 million US adults used psilocybin in 2025, and most past-year users microdosed
/events/2026-01-26-rand-psychedelic-use-.extract: RAND's nationally representative survey of 10,122 adults estimates 11 million Americans used psilocybin in 2025, 69% of past-year users microdosed, and roughly 10 million adults microdosed psilocybin, LSD, or MDMA.

/events/2026-07-30-osu-veterans-ptsd-pil.title: Ohio State pilot trial: 9 of 12 veterans with severe, treatment-resistant PTSD in remission one month after psilocybin-assisted therapy
/events/2026-07-30-osu-veterans-ptsd-pil.extract: An open-label pilot published in Communications Medicine found psilocybin-assisted therapy was safe and put 75% of 12 veterans with treatment-resistant PTSD into remission at one month, with no serious adverse events.

/events/2026-08-06-va-pivot-trial/.title: VA launches PIVOT, a five-site randomized trial of psilocybin for veterans with treatment-resistant depression
/events/2026-08-06-va-pivot-trial/.extract: The Department of Veterans Affairs announced a randomized controlled trial of at least 240 veterans with treatment-resistant depression, some with PTSD, comparing two psilocybin doses at five VA medical centers through 2031.
